title: Authentic Italian Cooking Class in Seattle (5-Course Meal)
blurb:
Step into a cozy kitchen in Seattle and discover the elegance of Italian cooking, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, this hands-on workshop with an esteemed pasta chef highlights refined flavors and timeless techniques.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Italian green beans with butter and Parmesan
- Pasta: Handmade pasta with brown butter and sage
- Main: Seafood risotto with scallops, shrimp and peas
- Main: Braised pork shoulder ragù with tomatoes and red wine
- Dessert: Vanilla bean panna cotta

With its intimate format and step-by-step guidance, this class is ideal for couples, families or groups of friends eager to explore authentic Italian cuisine together.
